verses.text: My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.

segments.text: My heart is fixed, O God;
I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.

verses.text: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.

segments.text: Awake, psaltery and harp:
I myself will awake right early.

verses.text: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

segments.text: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples;
And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

verses.text: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth reacheth unto the skies.

segments.text: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens;
And thy truth
reacheth
unto the skies.

verses.text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.

segments.text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens,
And thy glory above all the earth.

verses.text: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

segments.text: That thy beloved may be delivered,
Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

verses.text: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

segments.text: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult;
I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.text: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

segments.text: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine;
Ephraim also is the defence of my head;
Judah is my sceptre.

verses.text: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.

segments.text: Moab is my washpot;
Upon Edom will I cast my shoe;
Over Philistia will I shout.

verses.text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

segments.text: Who will bring me into the fortified city?
Who hath led me unto Edom?

verses.text: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

segments.text: Hast not thou cast us off, O God?
And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

verses.text: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

segments.text: Give us help against the adversary;
For vain is the help of man.

verses.text: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

segments.text: Through God we shall do valiantly:
For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

headings.text: A Song, a Psalm of David.
